text:
Alex C: Heads up — Acme's security questionnaire hit us with a few tight asks for the Thurs call: customer-managed KMS (BYOK) options, how we prove audit log integrity, and RBAC controls for per-tenant log access. Who can take which piece?

Samir Patel: We don't offer full CMK transfer for Hosted today. Private/Dedicated can use customer KMS. For Hosted we can do envelope encryption / key-wrapping with a customer-provided key via a KMS proxy, but legal + infra need to sign off. I'll dig in.

Maria Gomez: For log integrity we usually provide signed manifests + append-only S3 with Object Lock and write-once manifests. We can also provide HMAC digests over batches and a signed rotation proof. See internal: https://redwood.internal/docs/kms-audit-shipping 

Tony R: RBAC notes: logs include tenant_id; role-based access exists (roles: logs.viewer, logs.admin). Edge case is delegated project view — we need a mapping table from project -> principal. Also watch service account permissions for exporters. cc @Kate Li :eyes:

Kate Li: I'll draft a mapping and sample policy. For Hosted we can produce per-customer exported bundles (signed manifest + presigned s3 URL). Private customers can mount logs directly.

security-engineer: Questionnaire also wants rotation attestations. We rotate master keys quarterly, store rotation events in KMS audit log, and can provide a signed statement plus timestamped rotation records.

Samir Patel: Action: I'll validate BYOK path for Hosted and confirm whether we can support envelope wrapping with a customer-owned key (or require Dedicated) by EOD Wed. If blocked, propose KMS-proxy architecture as fallback.

Alex C: Also need a short note about the Envoy CVE that affected log forwarding — they asked if we've seen that and what we did.

Maria Gomez: CVE-2025-0421 — we patched envoy in the fleet on 2025-02-10, rotated forwarding creds, and verified re-delivery of buffered logs. I'll draft a 3-sentence blurb and attach timeline.

oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2025-0345 - Envoy CVE - patch rollout completed 2025-02-11.

Tony R: For the call I suggest a 1-page matrix: (KMS model) Hosted/Dedicated/Private + (Audit integrity) Signed manifests / Object Lock / SIEM push options + (RBAC) role names and filtering capabilities + (IR) recent CVE summary + remediation. I'll mock it up.

Kate Li: Sample manifest snippet I'll include in attachments:
```
manifest_version: 1
customer_id: acme-corp
time_range: 2025-02-01T00:00:00Z/2025-02-10T23:59:59Z
objects:
  - path: s3://redwood-audit/acme/2025-02-10/part-0001.jsonl
    sha256: 3b7f9d...a1e
    size_bytes: 1048576
signature: MEUCIQDf... (ECDSA-P256)
```

Samir Patel: Also add an example IAM snippet for logs.viewer so they can see least-privilege mapping.

Alex C: Great. @Samir Patel please update BYOK feasibility by EOD Wed. @Maria Gomez and @Kate Li can you prep the 2-pager + sample manifest and the 1-page matrix? I'll own the slides for the Thurs security call. :thumbsup:

Tony R: I'll review the matrix and add any SRE caveats re: retention/ingest.

Maria Gomez: Will attach CVE timeline and signed manifest example by EOD Tue.

Kate Li: Draft RBAC mapping and policy snippet by Tue EOD.

Alex C: Thanks all — prefer concise bullets for the customer. If anyone finds legal blocker on BYOK, @me and I'll coordinate with sales/legal before the call.
